terra.problem: “A border marker” says En-rogel appears in Benjamin’s border, but its cited passage does not say that. Add Joshua 18:16 to the passage reference.
In “A border marker,” “the Jebusites, which is Jerusalem” makes it sound as if the people were Jerusalem. Clarify that Jerusalem was the Jebusite city.
“Adonijah’s feast” omits that the men of Judah he invited were servants of the king. It would also be clearer to say he invited his royal brothers except Solomon.
